originals.citation: Foung, D. (2019). Making Good Suggestions in Analytics-Based Early Alert Systems: Shaping Minds and Changing Behaviours. Journal of Applied Research in Higher Education, 12(1), 109-.

quote: Rediscovering the Uptake of Dashboard Feedback: A Conceptual Replication of Foung (2019) ... this study aims to replicate an earlier study using a new data mining strategy, association rule mining ... After performing association rule mining with the original data set
notes: The paper cites two Foung 2019 works (Crossref reference list); the dashboard-recommendation-uptake study with a classification tree is the JARHE paper (ref 1), which matches @foung2019. The other, 'Mining students' data to identify at-risk students...' (CALL-EJ), is not on the list and is not the replicated study. Re-analysis of the original data set with a new method.
